message.content:
This vertical editorial illustration shows a magazine cover with a red left border. At the top, the white text "TEMPO" is overlaid with "50 Tahun!". Above this, white text reads "BEREBUT PARTAI KEBANGKITAN BANGSA" and "BABAK BARU SKANDAL KORUPSI BLBI" separated by a diagonal line.

The central image depicts a rolling green landscape under a blue and yellow sky. A large, stylized yellow sun radiates light, with a human face integrated into its center. The face wears glasses and smiles slightly. In the foreground, three stylized, rotund human figures are present: one in a yellow suit sits leaning back on a hill; one in a dark blue suit stands holding a clipboard; and one in an orange suit sits on the grass, using a grey laptop. To the right, a yellow excavator sits on a mound of brown earth.

Large black text on the left reads "MIMPI BUKIT ALGORITMA". Smaller black text below describes a project in Sukabumi, West Java. At the bottom, a barcode, a QR code, and publication details for April 2021 are visible.
